verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs say developers can inspect code that matches the design in open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON), and that layouts use real CSS Grid/Flex. It describes design as code that translates directly and that AI agents can read via MCP to connect tokens and implementation. However, the evidence shows inspect-level code output and AI-mediated workflows, not a documented component-to-code mapping system or code shown to be production-shippable. Missing for 10: component-to-codebase mapping (Code Connect-style), detail on what code inspect/export generates, and hands-on evidence that the output is shippable.
